Title: Raise max_tokens UI upper limit
Description: Increase AI config `max_tokens` input upper bound from 4000 to >=1000000 and ensure load/save does not clamp.
Acceptance: AI config dialog accepts >=1000000; typing first digit does not block 4+ digits; value persists to config.

Title: Stop empty-project AI auto completion & RAG leakage
Description: Prevent auto completion from triggering for empty/short context and when no project is open. Ensure project change clearing emits signals and unbinds vector store; skip RAG search on empty/placeholder queries; default completion_mode to manual when unset.
Acceptance: New empty project/document does not auto-trigger AI completion; switching to no-project clears vector store; RAG not queried for empty/placeholder queries.

Title: Fix bottom status bar clipping/overlap
Description: Fix bottom UI layout so status bar/editor status frame does not clip or overlap at common DPI/font sizes by removing hardcoded fixed heights and using size hints/font metrics; add a Qt geometry test.
Acceptance: Status bar and editor bottom status frame render without clipping/overlap in Qt geometry test at default and larger fonts.
